examples.arabic: هم يحتفلون بالأعياد معا ويتبادلون الهدايا والذكريات السعيدة.
examples.english: They celebrate the holidays together and exchange gifts and happy memories.
examples.transliteration: Hum yahtafulun bilaayad maan wayatabadalun alhadaya waladhikrayat alsaeida.

examples.arabic: بعد ان اطفا الشموع وابتسم في سعادة غامرة جاء دور فتح الهدايا بفارغ الصبر
examples.english: After he blew out the candles and smiled with overwhelming happiness, it was time to eagerly open the gifts.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da an atfa'a al-shumu' wa ibtasama fi sa'ada ghamira ja'a dawr fath al-hadaya bi-farigh al-sabr.
